latest_release.name: BitChord v1.10
latest_release.body:
![BitChord banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kushagrasinghx/BitChord/main/Banner.png)

## Top Features

- Replay Year: your year in music as animated, shareable stories.
- Google Drive backup: back up, restore and auto-sync, and Replay adds up listening from all your devices.
- Radio: a new Radio tab in the bottom bar.
- Best Part: a button on the artwork that skips to the part of the song people replay most.
- YouTube Premium audio: Premium users can stream the higher-quality ~256 kbps Opus.
- Keep liked songs downloaded: liked songs download automatically and stay offline.
- Animated lyrics share: a synced video clip with the song, in story format by default.
- AutoMix artwork transitions: smooth, organic cover changes between mixed songs.
- Queue: swipe actions, undo and multi-select.

## Changelog

- Smaller app: the Automix model now downloads the first time you turn it on, so the APK is about half the size.
- Player: Apple Music-style button animations, optional total duration instead of time left, a toggle to hide the lyrics preview, and a toggle to disable Spotify Canvas.
- Song Info: song credits.
- Quick Settings: a tile to play or pause your last queue.
- Sleep timer: a gradual 30-second fade-out.
- Search: filter YouTube Music results to your library, and swipe to queue or long-press live results while typing.
- Playlists and albums: find a playlist in Add to playlist, Add to playlists in album menus, and a track number sort for local albums.
- Artwork: high-res covers for YouTube video tracks, no more low-res or flickering covers during transitions, and local tracks and opened files show their own cover.
- Lyrics: YouTube Music timed lyrics instead of a static sheet, synced lyrics preferred over plain ones, and lyrics read from local MP3s.
- Lyrics: a smoother karaoke sweep that holds through pause and resume, a refreshed strip glow, RTL translations aligned under their lines, and a fixed Chinese translation.
- Playback: sorted playlists and albums play in the order shown, AC-4 audio plays through FFmpeg, and the loudness limiter engages with spatial audio to prevent distortion.
- Queue: opens at upcoming songs, history replays no longer re-queue, and the redundant Now playing row is removed.
- Android Auto and notification: the app's own shuffle from outside controllers, a fixed playlist context, correct notification icons, and Next no longer likes the song.
- Library: long playlists keep loading and can be fully reordered, and imported playlists can be renamed, edited and deleted.
- Replay: listening on remote speakers counts, and Top albums no longer crashes on Yearly or Lifetime.
- Song matching: accent-insensitive titles and artists, and better CJK romanized titles.
- Navigation: tap the active tab to scroll to the top.
- Fixed music video full screen on tablets, search results, and YouTube Recents on Direct Source Stream.
- General stability fixes across the app.

Full list of changes: https://github.com/kushagrasinghx/BitChord/pull/1717

## Install

**Android** (8.0 / API 26+): installs straight over v1.9.1 with the same signing key. Not sure which APK to take? Use the universal `BitChord-v1.10.apk`. The smaller ones are `arm64-v8a` (most phones), `armeabi-v7a` (old 32-bit phones) and `x86_64` (emulators, Chromebooks).

**Android TV / Google TV / Fire TV** (8.0 / API 26+): installs over v1.9.1 TV, or updates from inside the app. Use the universal `BitChordTV-v1.10.apk`, or the smaller `BitChordTV-v1.10_armeabi-v7a.apk`, which suits most TVs and streaming sticks (`arm64-v8a` for newer boxes like the Shield or Chromecast with Google TV).

**Wear OS** (Wear OS 3+): the watch app ships inside the phone app. Install or update it from Settings > BitChord for Wear OS.

# BitChord ### Aesthetic YouTube Music Client
[![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/kushagrasinghx/BitChord?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=0d1117)](https://github.com/kushagrasinghx/BitChord/releases) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/kushagrasinghx/BitChord?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=0d1117)](https://github.com/kushagrasinghx/BitChord/blob/main/LICENSE) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/kushagrasinghx/BitChord/total?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=0d1117)](https://github.com/kushagrasinghx/BitChord/releases) [![Listening now](https://api.bitchord.kushagrasingh.in/api/stats/live/badge.svg)](https://api.bitchord.kushagrasingh.in/api/stats/live)
[**Download**](#download) · [**Features**](#features) · [**Contributing**](#contributing) · [**Support**](#support) · [**Disclaimer**](#disclaimer)
> [!IMPORTANT] > BitChord is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to YouTube or Google in any way. Use it at your own discretion. ---

Features

#### Playback - **Search, browse and play** anything available on YouTube Music. - **Hi-Res lossless audio** — FLAC/ALAC from a configured module source, with YouTube Music as fallback. - **Gapless playback with true crossfade**, adjustable 0–12s. - **Automix [Beta]** — DJ-style transitions with beat-matching and tempo-stretching. - **Offline downloads** — save tracks with embedded metadata. - **Local music library** integration. - **Background playback** via a proper foreground media session. - **Apple-like lyrics animation** — credit to [binimum](https://github.com/binimum/am-lyrics). #### Connectivity & Accounts - **Sign in with your Google account** for personalized content. - **Spotify integration** — connect your account to play your playlists and Liked Songs. - **Discord Rich Presence** — in-app login, live track/artist/album and progress. - **Scrobbling** to Last.fm and ListenBrainz. - **Pluggable sources** — add, edit, test and health-check module sources. #### Experience - **Animated album canvas** — motion artwork on the now-playing screen. - **Word-synced lyrics** — word/syllable-level highlighting from multiple sources. - **Lyrics providers** — credit to [lrc.red](https://lrc.red), [BiniLyrics](https://github.com/binimum), [BetterLyrics](https://github.com/better-lyrics/better-lyrics), [PaxSenix](https://lyrics.paxsenix.org), [LyricsPlus](https://github.com/ibratabian17/YouLyPlus), [SimpMusic](https://github.com/maxrave-dev/SimpMusic), [Unison](https://unison.boidu.dev), [Megalobiz](https://www.megalobiz.com), [KuGou](https://www.kugou.com), [LRCLIB](https://lrclib.net), [Musixmatch](https://www.musixmatch.com) and [Genius](https://genius.com). - **Dynamic, artwork-driven theming** — Material palette extracted from album art. - **Frosted-glass UI** — Telegram-style translucent bars via Haze, Material 3 theming. #### Controls & Tweaks - **Per-network audio quality** — separate quality ceilings for Wi-Fi and mobile data. - **Playback speed control** (0.5×–2.0×) and **skip silence**. - **Sleep timer** — fixed presets or "stop after this track". - **System equalizer** integration. - **Bit-perfect USB exclusive output** — sends lossless tracks to a USB DAC unchanged, at each track's own rate and bit depth. Thanks to [Mornye](https://github.com/mornyeapp/Mornye) for the reference. - **Stats for nerds** — codec, bit depth, sample rate, and more on the now-playing screen.
---

Download

Grab the latest signed APK from the [Releases](https://github.com/kushagrasinghx/BitChord/releases) page. Sideloading requires enabling "Install unknown apps" for whichever app you download it with.
